comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks — this crash report is interesting because the entire stack is inside Windows Forms' own DPI-change handling: a ComboBox rebuilding its window handle while a `WM_DPICHANGED_BEFOREPARENT` message is processed. No mRemoteNG code appears in the trace, and the app kept running (non-fatal).

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Filed automatically by the crash reporter, so there is nobody to ask — here is what we could and could not establish ourselves.

The stack is a display-scaling change: Windows sends the DPI-change message, WinForms rescales the font, and a ComboBox recreates its window handle — which failed.
